summary: Deterministic CSS confetti decoration for a celebration; non-interactive and ignored by screen readers.
whenToUse: Add a decorative accent to an achievement or celebration.
Use only when motion is not needed to understand the content.
whenNotToUse: Communicating a result or state through animation alone.
In reduced-motion or forced-colors environments, where it is hidden.

props.name: particleCount
props.description: Deterministic number of decorative elements, limited to 1–16.

accessibility: The decorative container has aria-hidden="true" and does not receive focus.
Animation is disabled by hiding the effect with prefers-reduced-motion.
The effect is also hidden in forced-colors mode.
responsive: Fills the container positioned by the caller without intercepting pointer or touch input.
customization: Colors and sizes derive from --dc-* tokens; particleCount is limited to 16.
commonMistakes: Using the effect to convey important information or making it interactive.
limits: CSS-only: does not pick random colors or positions; the effect is hidden with reduced motion.
